description: Ledger 12 normalized single-point Kerr/intensity comparison and its explicit limits.

siege_cell_decisions.rationale: Ledger 12 tested the intensity interface at one normalized noiseless point and found no Kerr corrected-capacity or delayed-memory advantage.
siege_cell_decisions.decision_scope: One seed and one normalized noiseless parameter point under the Ledger 12 estimator.

protocols.name: Ledger 12 first matched Kerr control
protocols.decision_scope: One normalized noiseless point, 55 targets through degree three and lag four, with an earlier pooled-null estimator superseded for inference by Ledger 13.

runs.summary: Both Kerr and Kerr-disabled totals remained below numerical rank, but Kerr reduced corrected total capacity by 0.005961 and supplied no useful delayed-memory gain. Intensity nonlinearity was already present in the square-law observation control.

gate_results.decision_scope: Attempted falsification of the finite observed-rank bound at one point.
gate_results.limitation: Not a proof; target family ends at degree three and lag four.

gate_results.decision_scope: Kerr minus matched Kerr-disabled intensity control at the frozen Ledger 12 point.
gate_results.limitation: One seed and one normalized noiseless parameter point.

comparisons.control_relationship: Matched Kerr-disabled intensity case within the same run suite
comparisons.metric: corrected total capacity, Kerr minus disabled
